english.title: Aviation fuel installation manager fail to ensure aircraft fuel properly stored and marked
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an aviation fuel installation manager, caused or permitted fuel to be delivered to the installation at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when not satisfied that

(A)_[the installation was capable of storing and dispensing the fuel so as not to render it unfit for use in aircraft]_
(B)_[the installation was marked in a manner appropriate to the grade of fuel stored]_
(C)_[each part of the installation in which fuel was stored was marked in a manner appropriate to the grade of fuel stored in that part]_
(D)_[fuel delivered from a vehicle had been sampled and was of a grade appropriate to that installation and was fit for use in aircraft]_
(E)_[fuel delivered from a vessel had been sampled and was of a grade appropriate to that installation and was fit for use in aircraft]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 220(1) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
